threat: Stolen user credentials used to access the customer portal
attack_path: Credential stuffing or phishing leads to unauthorized login
recommended_controls: MFA, account lockout, impossible travel detection, login alerting

threat: API authorization bypass exposes another customer's records
attack_path: Attacker modifies customer_id or object reference in API request
recommended_controls: Object-level authorization, deny-by-default access checks, automated authorization tests

threat: Public object storage exposes uploaded customer files
attack_path: Storage bucket or container is accidentally made public
recommended_controls: Private storage, bucket policies, encryption, access logging, CSPM checks

attack_path: Privileged changes cannot be investigated or attributed
recommended_controls: Centralized audit logging, immutable logs, admin activity monitoring

threat: CI/CD secrets are exposed in source code repository
attack_path: Secret committed to repository and used by attacker
recommended_controls: Secret scanning, pre-commit hooks, secret vaulting, key rotation

threat: Public API is overwhelmed by automated requests
attack_path: Bot traffic or scripted requests exhaust API resources
recommended_controls: Rate limiting, WAF rules, autoscaling, request throttling

attack_path: Unsanitized input is used in a database query
recommended_controls: Parameterized queries, input validation, SAST, DAST testing

threat: Weak service-to-service authentication allows internal spoofing
attack_path: A service sends requests without strong identity validation
recommended_controls: mTLS, service identity, short-lived tokens, network segmentation

threat: Overly broad cloud IAM role allows privilege escalation
attack_path: Compromised pipeline identity has excessive permissions
recommended_controls: Least privilege IAM, permission boundaries, role review, deployment approvals

threat: Application logs expose tokens or sensitive customer data
attack_path: Sensitive data is written to logs and viewed by unauthorized users
recommended_controls: Log redaction, sensitive data filtering, access controls, retention policy

threat: Unsafe file upload enables malicious content storage
attack_path: Attacker uploads unsafe files or bypasses content validation
recommended_controls: File type validation, malware scanning, storage isolation, signed URLs

threat: Status endpoint leaks application or infrastructure details
attack_path: Unauthenticated endpoint exposes version, stack, or internal details
recommended_controls: Authentication, response minimization, secure headers, endpoint review

attack_path: Data exposure impact increases if storage is compromised
recommended_controls: Encryption at rest, managed keys, key rotation, database access monitoring

threat: Weak session cookie settings allow session theft
attack_path: Cookies lack Secure, HttpOnly, or SameSite protections
recommended_controls: Secure cookie flags, session rotation, short idle timeout, TLS enforcement

threat: Vulnerable dependency is deployed into production
attack_path: Known vulnerable package is built and deployed
recommended_controls: SCA scanning, dependency pinning, patch SLAs, build failure on critical findings
